findings.source_quote: Thy hand from ev’ry snare and foe / Shall great deliverance bring.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the two lines with: “U hand sal groot verlossing bring / van elke strik en vyand.” This more clearly preserves that deliverance is brought from every snare and foe.
findings.translation_quote: U hand sal uit elke strik en vyand / groot verlossing bring.

findings.source_quote: Her hymns of love and praise.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider “haar liedere van liefde en lofprysing” for a more natural rendering of “hymns of love and praise.”
findings.translation_quote: haar lofsange van liefde en lof.
